Company Description

About us

Solflare is one of the fastest-growing crypto wallets in the world. With around 3.5 million monthly active users and over $20 billion in digital assets secured through our platform, we’re building a powerful gateway to Web3. Founded in 2021, Solflare now has a team of nearly 100 people, with offices in Zagreb, Belgrade, and Novi Sad, plus remote teams across the globe. Our vision is simple but bold: a world where everyone uses a Web3 wallet and has full control over their assets – achieving true financial independence.

Our culture

At Solflare, we’re on a mission to empower people to truly own and thrive – starting with our own team. We take on bold challenges with curiosity, grit, and a deep sense of accountability. Here, progress means learning fast, solving smart, and showing up for each other without ego. You’ll join a team where we question the status quo, celebrate shared wins, and never settle for “just good enough.” If you’re excited by growth – yours, ours, and society’s – you’ll feel right at home.

Job Description

The role

As a Senior Data Analyst at Solflare, you’ll dive deep into data to uncover insights and trends that help us make better decisions about our product and its growth. You’ll work closely with product managers, engineers, and other teams to turn complex, raw data into clear and actionable insights. Your work will directly influence important decisions, from improving existing product features and identifying opportunities for new ones to shaping our market expansion strategy.

What makes analytics at Solflare particularly interesting is the depth and variety of data available to us. Since blockchain data is public, we can analyze user behavior at the individual transaction level across the wider Solana ecosystem, not just within Solflare. This means that a user’s journey does not necessarily start when they first open or create a Solflare wallet. Blockchain data allows us to understand parts of their activity before they become a Solflare user, including which wallets and protocols they used, how they transacted, where their assets moved, and how their behavior changed after adopting Solflare.

Analyzing the blockchain gives us the opportunity to answer questions that traditional product analytics often cannot. We can track market shares, explore how users interact with competing companies, where assets are moving, and which products or behaviors are gaining traction across the ecosystem.

By combining this on-chain information with our off-chain product data, such as app activity, event tracking, and internal user data, we get a uniquely rich view of the full user journey. You might investigate what users do on-chain after using Solflare, identify behavioral patterns connected to retention or churn, or uncover opportunities for new products, features, and integrations.

If you’re excited by complex data, curious about user behavior, and ready to work in a role where your insights can directly shape product strategy and company growth, we’d love to hear from you.

Core responsibilities:

  • Data collection: You’ll gather data from a variety of sources (databases, APIs, spreadsheets) and ensure it’s accurate, complete, and relevant to the business questions at hand.
  • Data preparation: Actively contributing to our data pipeline, building and maintaining the transformation logic that turns raw data into analysis-ready datasets.
  • Exploratory analysis: Use statistical techniques and data visualization to uncover trends, patterns, and correlations in the data. This will help guide the team in making data-driven decisions.
  • Reporting & visualization: You’ll create clear and insightful dashboards, reports, and charts, making it easy for stakeholders to understand the findings and take action.
  • Collaboration with teams: Work alongside product managers, engineers, and other stakeholders to define key metrics and provide data-driven recommendations that shape the product roadmap.
  • Data integrity: Ensure that the data is secure, well-documented, and accessible to those who need it most.

Qualifications

Requirements

  • Experience: 5+ years of experience in data analysis or engineering involving large amounts of different types of data
  • Statistical analysis: Experience with hypothesis testing, A/B testing, and other statistical methods.
  • Programming & data manipulation: Proficiency in at least one programming language for data cleaning, transformation, and analysis.
  • SQL: Strong skills in writing and optimizing SQL queries to extract and aggregate data from databases.
  • Data visualization tools: Experience with business intelligence tools such as Tableau, Power BI, Looker, or similar.
  • AI-assisted development: Experience integrating AI tools (e.g. Claude Code) into your engineering workflow for faster iteration and higher-quality output
  • Spreadsheets: Solid experience using Excel or Google Sheets for quick analysis and pivot tables.
  • ETL & data workflow: Basic understanding of ETL processes and tools to move data from different sources into a usable format.

Nice to have:

  • Fintech/banking/insurance industry experience
  • Experience with processing blockchain data (e.g. using data from Dune, Solscan, etc.).

Additional Information

Personality Traits We Value

  • Problem-solvers: You see roadblocks as opportunities and don’t wait around for someone else to fix things.
  • Self-starters: You take initiative, follow through, and deliver with pride – no excuses, no shortcuts.
  • Team players: You thrive in a “we, not me” culture, lifting others up while sharing the load.
  • Adaptable minds: You embrace change, question how things are done, and constantly look for better ways.
  • Ownership mindset: You own your work end-to-end, communicate openly, and learn from every challenge.

Why Solflare?

  • Make an impact: Your work will directly shape how people interact with and understand crypto wallets, empowering users around the globe.
  • Work with the best: Collaborate with a talented, driven team across design, engineering, and product to build innovative, user-first experiences.
  • Flexibility: Remote or office – up to you. Enjoy a flexible work environment based on trust that supports your well-being and fosters creativity, as well as flexible work time – work when you are most productive, with no micromanagement.
  • Perks & benefits: individual education budget, cool team buildings, private health insurance, to name a few.
  • Learn about Crypto: No crypto experience? No problem! You’ll be part of a team that will teach you the ropes and help you grow into an expert.

Join us at Solflare and be part of something bigger than yourself. We’re not just reacting to trends; we’re building the future. If you’re ready to push boundaries, challenge assumptions, and make an impact, we want to hear from you.

Apply now and help us shape the future of decentralized finance.
descriptions.job-1797c9r:
Phantom is on a mission to connect the world to the freedom of open markets. Tens of millions of people all over the world use Phantom to access global markets that never close, including perpetuals, prediction markets, tokenized assets, stablecoins and memes. Phantom users are able to discover the markets that matter and the cultural moments that shape them, building conviction through real-time data and the verified performance of top traders. With self-custody and access to open networks at its core, Phantom lets them control their financial moves in the same app they use to safely store or spend money worldwide.

Phantom has reached #1 in Google Play's finance category and consistently ranks in the top 50 apps across all categories. Phantom partners with many of the most trusted and influential names in finance like Hyperliquid, Stripe, Kalshi and Visa, to make the most popular and innovative financial products accessible to everyone.

We are around 180 people, fully remote, backed by a $150M Series C investment from a16z, Sequoia Capital and Paradigm.

Responsibilities

As a Trust, Risk & Safety Engineer at Phantom, you’ll build the systems that safeguard our users, products, and platform. Working across the stack, you’ll detect and prevent abuse, assess emerging risks, reduce financial loss, and equip internal teams with the tools and intelligence needed to respond quickly and effectively. The ideal candidate brings high agency, a strong sense of ownership, exceptional technical judgment and product taste, a relentless work ethic, and the emotional intelligence to navigate complex, high-stakes situations.

  • Fraud prevention: Build real-time risk controls and decisioning systems for products such as ACH, debit cards, onramps, off-ramps, and other money movement experiences.

  • Scam and abuse detection: Develop signals, models, and product interventions that identify malicious wallets, transactions, applications, and user behavior.

  • Identity and compliance infrastructure: Build scalable KYC, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, case management, and audit systems.

  • Data and intelligence: Create pipelines and tools that combine on-chain activity, product data, and third-party signals into actionable risk insights.

  • Product safety: Partner with product and engineering teams to design safeguards into new features from the beginning without compromising the user experience.

  • Operational tooling: Build internal tools that help Risk, Compliance, Support, and Security teams investigate incidents and take action efficiently.

  • Team building: Help establish the technical foundations and engineering culture for a new, high-impact function at Phantom.



Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or a related technical field, or equivalent practical experience

  • 8+ years of full-time software engineering experience

  • Experience designing and operating reliable, data-intensive production systems

  • Strong product judgment and the ability to balance user experience, financial risk, and operational complexity

  • Ability to work across frontend, backend, APIs, data pipelines, and third-party integrations

  • Demonstrated interest in protecting users and building trustworthy financial products

  • Nice to have: Experience with fraud, risk, identity, KYC, AML, sanctions, payments, fintech, or blockchain systems

  • English language proficiency

Why Work with Us

  • First impressions matter: Wallets are responsible for a users first impression with crypto and onboarding new users into crypto. By ensuring that a user has a great first-time experience with crypto, we can help supercharge the growth of the entire ecosystem.

  • Make crypto easier to navigate: There is no easy way for a user to discover and navigate all that crypto has to offer. Wallets have a unique opportunity to help users not only onboard to crypto but also stay retained by exploring new things to do.

  • We live in a multi-chain world: We currently support Solana, Ethereum, Polygon and Bitcoin with more networks to come in the new future. We are focused on creating a unified, multi-chain crypto experience for users.

Benefits

  • Competitive salary and equity

  • Comprehensive insurance (medical/dental/vision) — 100% covered

  • Stipend for your ideal remote set-up

  • Flexible hours and a supportive remote environment

  • Unlimited vacation: Take time when you need it (and we really mean it!)

  • 401(k) retirement plan

  • Monthly wellness benefit

  • Weekly meal benefit

  • Global off-sites

The target base salary for this role will range between $200,000 to $250,000 with the addition of equity and benefits. This is determined by a few factors including your skillset, prior relevant experience, quality of interviews and market factors (such as location) at the point in time of offer.

We strongly encourage candidates of all backgrounds to apply. We believe that our work is stronger with a variety of perspectives, and we’re eager to further diversify our company. If you have a background that you feel would make an impact at Phantom, please consider applying. We’re committed to building an inclusive, supportive place for you to do the best work of your career.

By submitting your resume and application materials, you acknowledge and agree that Phantom Technologies, Inc. ("Phantom") collects and processes your personal information (including application materials, interview records, and related data) to evaluate your candidacy. Phantom may use AI-powered tools and third-party service providers for transcription, note-taking, scheduling, and other administrative tasks. Phantom does not sell your information and your materials will be handled securely and in accordance with applicable data protection laws.

Square is looking for a strategic, hands-on senior leader to lead our US Business Development Representative (BDR) organization. The BDR team is a critical growth engine for Square, responsible for creating high-quality pipeline, identifying new seller opportunities, and developing future sales talent across our go-to-market organization.

As Senior Manager, Business Development Representatives, you will lead the US BDR motion through BDR Managers and frontline teams responsible for outbound prospecting, lead qualification, pipeline generation, and seller engagement. You will own the operating rhythm, performance system, and pipeline generation strategy for the US market, partnering closely with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, and Strategy to improve how Square identifies, engages, qualifies, and converts high-potential sellers.

You will be responsible for building a predictable, performance-driven BD motion that supports Square’s revenue goals while developing future sales talent. This role requires a leader who can set strategy, drive execution, inspect performance, coach managers, improve systems, and ensure the team consistently delivers high-quality pipeline that converts into meaningful revenue outcomes.

Success in this role will be measured by the team’s ability to consistently generate high-quality pipeline, improve conversion across the funnel, increase BDR-sourced revenue contribution, strengthen AE partnership, improve manager effectiveness, and develop BDR talent into future roles across Square Sales.

You will:

  • Lead the day-to-day execution and long-term improvement of Square’s US BDR motion, ensuring the team consistently delivers high-quality pipeline against sales goals.
  • Own the US BDR pipeline generation strategy, translating revenue goals, territory priorities, AE capacity, and market opportunities into clear outbound and self-sourcing plans.
  • Manage, coach, and develop BDR Managers and frontline contributors, helping them improve performance and prepare for future roles within Square Sales.
  • Build manager capability by coaching frontline leaders on performance management, inspection, difficult conversations, team motivation, rep development, and consistent execution.
  • Own execution against BD performance goals, including sourced opportunities, qualified meetings, conversion rates, pipeline value, AE acceptance, stage progression, and contribution to closed revenue.
  • Establish and manage a consistent operating cadence across the team, including forecasting, pipeline reviews, performance inspection, coaching rhythms, capacity planning, and monthly/quarterly planning.
  • Build scalable systems for hiring, onboarding, ramp, coaching, performance management, and career progression across the BDR organization.
  • Translate BD strategy into clear team priorities, expectations, and actions that drive consistent execution across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, and seller segments.
  • Execute outbound and self-sourcing strategies that help Square reach high-potential sellers across priority verticals, geographies, and segments.
  • Partner closely with Sales leadership to align BD execution with revenue targets, territory strategy, AE capacity, pipeline needs, and market opportunities.
  • Work cross-functionally with Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, Product Marketing, and Strategy to improve lead quality, messaging, routing, reporting, tooling, seller engagement, and funnel conversion.
  • Use data to identify performance trends across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, lead sources, and seller segments, then turn those insights into coaching, process improvements, and execution plans.
  • Establish a clear performance management framework that connects activity, meetings, qualified opportunities, pipeline value, AE acceptance, stage progression, and closed revenue contribution.
  • Improve team productivity through effective use of sales technology, automation, prospecting tools, funnel management practices, and coaching workflows.
  • Identify opportunities to use AI, automation, data enrichment, and sales engagement tools to improve account prioritization, prospecting quality, personalization, coaching, and rep productivity.
  • Pilot new outbound plays, cadences, messaging, tools, and workflows; measure results and scale what works across the US BDR organization.
  • Hire, onboard, and retain high-performing BDR talent while supporting clear career progression into Account Executive, Account Management, Sales Leadership, and other roles within Square Sales.
  • Build a culture of accountability, urgency, curiosity, inclusion, high standards, and continuous improvement.
  • Represent the BDR function in Sales leadership forums, providing frontline insights, performance trends, risks, recommendations, and executional feedback that improve Square’s sales development strategy.

You have

  • 8+ years of experience in sales, business development, sales development, or another revenue-focused role in a high-growth environment.
  • 4+ years of experience in Sales Development, Business Development, outbound sales, pipeline generation, or lead qualification.
  • 4+ years of people leadership experience, including experience managing managers, team leads, or large frontline sales/BDR teams.
  • Experience managing managers or leading multi-layered frontline revenue teams.
  • A track record of leading teams that consistently meet or exceed pipeline generation, opportunity creation, activity, or revenue contribution goals.
  • Strong fluency in sales development metrics, including activity, conversion, meeting quality, AE acceptance, pipeline value, stage progression, and closed revenue contribution.
  • Experience managing execution in a metrics-driven sales environment, including forecasting, pacing, KPI inspection, pipeline reviews, capacity planning, and performance coaching.
  • Strong ability to diagnose performance gaps across managers, reps, markets, campaigns, lead sources, territories, or seller segments and translate insights into clear action plans.
  • Experience coaching sales managers and/or frontline reps to improve productivity, quality, consistency, accountability, and career readiness.
  • Experience executing outbound prospecting, self-sourcing, lead qualification, or sales development motions.
  • Strong cross-functional partnership skills, especially with Sales, Marketing, Revenue Operations, Enablement, Analytics, Product Marketing, or Strategy.
  • Ability to communicate performance trends, priorities, risks, and recommendations clearly to senior sales leaders.
  • Strong organizational, communication, and leadership skills, with the ability to drive accountability across teams.
  • Comfort operating in a fast-paced environment where goals, priorities, tools, and processes continue to evolve.

Preferred qualifications

  • Experience in SaaS, financial services, payments, commerce, or another high-transaction-volume sales environment.
  • Experience managing managers or multi-layered sales development teams.
  • Experience using Salesforce, Outreach/Salesloft, Looker, Gong, or similar CRM, sales engagement, analytics, and coaching tools.

Block builds simple, powerful tools that make progress towards an economy that’s truly open to all.

Each of our brands unlocks different aspects of the economy for more people. Square makes commerce and financial services accessible to sellers. Cash App is the easy way to spend, send, and store money. Afterpay is transforming the way customers manage their spending over time. TIDAL is a music platform that empowers artists to thrive as entrepreneurs. Bitkey is a simple self-custody wallet built for bitcoin. Proto is a suite of bitcoin mining products and services. Together, we’re helping build a financial system that is open to everyone. Join us.

The Role

The AI & DX Analytics team exists to measure and improve Block's developer experience and investment in AI. We turn raw engineering signals (agent session data, pull request and CI activity, and AI spend) into reporting and analysis that shape leadership's AI investment decisions, and drive improvement in AI ROI and developer experience.

We're hiring a Senior Analytics Engineer to own parts of that pipeline end to end. This role drives two key parts: You will instrument new telemetry at the source and build production pipelines that turn it into governed data. You will then turn that governed data into executive-facing reporting that leadership will use to decide where AI investment is working and where to redirect it, and into the analysis that surfaces concrete opportunities to improve AI ROI and developer experience. You'll define new metrics and craft the visual narrative — the charts, dashboards, and presentation materials — that make them land with an executive audience. AI-first workflows are central to how this team operates and critical to succeeding in this role: using AI coding agents is a default part of how you build and maintain pipelines and dashboards. You’ll excel in this role if you're as comfortable defining and visualizing a brand new executive-facing metric from a messy signal as you are debugging why a pipeline silently stalled overnight.

You will

Instrumentation & Telemetry:

  • Instrument and extend the raw telemetry captured about AI usage, code changes, CI/CD activity, and spend — building new data capture, not only transforming what already exists. This is core to the role, as evolving AI tools and increased AI adoption constantly creates new signals that need to be captured.
  • Partner with data engineers on production ETL pipelines that land that telemetry into governed tables, with the freshness monitoring, backfills, and alerting that keep it trustworthy, rather than a one-off script.
  • Define new metrics out of ambiguous or evolving signals, and earn stakeholder trust in a new number by validating and reconciling it until it holds up.

Dashboards & analysis:

  • Build and ship the executive-facing dashboards and visualizations that turn governed metrics into decision-ready reporting — with the polish and precision a room of executives will scrutinize.
  • Run the analysis that a new chart or metric needs and anticipate questions that an executive audience will ask, then bring senior stakeholders a recommendation, not just a number, and defend the methodology behind both.
  • Translate complex, technical findings into a clear narrative: the headline chart and the one sentence that makes an executive act on it.

Across both:

  • Use AI coding agents as a default part of how you write, test, and maintain data pipelines, dashboards, and analyses.
  • Partner across data engineering, applied AI, and data science teams to keep telemetry connected end to end — the raw signal you capture directly feeds the session classifiers, not just the dashboards you build.
  • Turn what the data shows into action: flag where AI spend isn't paying off or where developer friction is most costly, and push the tooling, process, or investment changes that address it.

Qualifications

You have:

  • 8+ years in analytics engineering, data engineering, or business intelligence, with a track record of owning production data pipelines and insights end to end, not just writing ad hoc queries.
  • Background in developer experience, engineering productivity, measuring AI effectiveness, or platform analytics.
  • Strong SQL and Python, with hands-on experience building and operating data pipelines against a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Experience partnering with engineering teams to define and instrument new event or telemetry data, not only transforming data that is already captured.
  • Experience building dashboards or internal tools that non-technical stakeholders rely on to make decisions, and the judgment to know when something is decision-ready versus still an analysis.
  • Comfortable owning a dashboard's performance and data layer, not just its charts — able to profile a slow query, rework a caching or prequery layer, and ship the frontend changes yourself in a framework like React; we'll help you ramp up if this is new.
  • Comfort with git, CI/CD systems, and debugging production pipeline failures such as retries and backfills.
  • Workflows built around AI coding agents as a primary tool for writing and maintaining code.
  • Strong written and verbal communication, with experience presenting technical findings and methodology directly to senior stakeholders.
  • A track record of producing polished charts and materials for executive audiences — comfortable sweating details like labeling, framing, and precision 
  • Demonstrated ability to lead cross-team collaboration.

Even better:

  • Experience with a metrics-governance or semantic-layer system, such as a metrics store, dbt semantic layer, or LookML.

Technologies we use and teach: SQL (Snowflake), Python, TypeScript and React, Git, CI/CD pipelines, a governed metrics store, AI coding agents, and LLM-based classification tooling.

descriptions.job-0ynagyn:
Join us in building the future of finance.

Our mission is to democratize finance for all. An estimated $124 trillion of assets will be inherited by younger generations in the next two decades. The largest transfer of wealth in human history. If you’re ready to be at the epicenter of this historic cultural and financial shift, keep reading.

About the team + role

We are building an elite team, applying frontier technologies to the world's biggest financial problems. We're looking for bold thinkers. Sharp problem-solvers. Builders who are wired to make an impact. Robinhood isn't a place for complacency, it's where ambitious people do the best work of their careers. We're a high-performing, fast-moving team with ethics at the center of everything we do. Expectations are high, and so are the rewards.

The Developer Infrastructure org is the engine behind Robinhood's entire engineering organization — a collection of tightly integrated teams whose collective mission is to make every engineer at Robinhood faster, more reliable, and exponentially more productive. The org spans four major teams: DevX (Developer Experience), TestX (Test Infrastructure), Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform. DevX owns Robinhood's monorepo and Bazel-based build infrastructure — the critical layer between a developer writing code and that code being ready to ship — along with the company's full CI/CD pipeline and remote build execution cluster. TestX owns the infrastructure behind Robinhood's entire test experience: the integration test environments, and personal development environments that serve as miniature simulations of the full Robinhood system, giving engineers a safe, isolated space to test their code end-to-end before it ever touches production. Backend Platform and Mobile Platform own the core language runtimes, libraries, IDEs, and developer toolchains across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android. Together, these teams share a single north star: leveraging AI and agentic systems to fundamentally transform Robinhood's software development lifecycle — making every engineer dramatically more productive and the entire org a force multiplier for the business.

As the Senior Staff Software Developer, Developer Infrastructure, you are the technical driver of this entire org — the Uber Tech Lead unifying DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform under one cohesive technical vision. Your primary focus will be DevX, owning the technical direction of Robinhood's most critical build and developer infrastructure. But your influence stretches far wider: you will be a driving force in weaving AI and agentic development deeply into every layer of the software development lifecycle — from intelligent code review and automated build pipelines to agentic coding systems that multiply what each engineer can ship. This is a rare opportunity to shape not just how Robinhood builds software today, but what engineering velocity looks like for the entire industry!

This role is based in our Toronto office, with in-person attendance expected at least 3 days per week.

At Robinhood, we believe in the power of in-person work to accelerate progress, spark innovation, and strengthen community. Our office experience is intentional, energizing, and designed to fully support high-performing teams.

What you’ll do

  • Own the technical direction and roadmap for the Developer Infrastructure org — serving as the Uber Tech Lead across DevX, TestX, Backend Platform, and Mobile Platform, unifying four engineering teams under a shared technical vision
  • Lead and evolve Robinhood's Bazel-based monorepo build infrastructure — own the remote build execution cluster, drive language-agnostic build optimization across Python, Go, TypeScript, and more, and ensure fast, stable feedback loops for the entire engineering org
  • Scale CI/CD pipelines to support thousands of daily builds with speed, safety, and reliability — overseeing GitHub repository configurations, pre-merge checks, and test execution infrastructure across the company
  • Drive the vision for TestX — the test infrastructure and environments that power Robinhood's entire test experience, including integration test environments and personal development environments that simulate the full Robinhood system so engineers can test safely and confidently
  • Champion the integration of AI and agentic systems across the full software development lifecycle — driving initiatives that use intelligent automation and coding agents to multiply developer velocity, improve code quality, and accelerate the pace of innovation across the org
  • Set technical standards across Backend Platform and Mobile Platform — owning the vision for core language runtimes, libraries, IDE tooling, and developer environment security across Python, Go, TypeScript, Swift, and Android
  • Partner with engineering leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to define and execute a long-term developer infrastructure roadmap that embeds AI as a force multiplier at every layer of the SDLC

What you bring

  • 10+ years of software engineering experience with a demonstrated track record at the Senior Staff, Principal, or Distinguished Engineer level — you've set technical direction at the org or company level, not just the team level
  • Deep expertise with Bazel and large-scale monorepo build systems — you've owned remote build execution infrastructure at scale and understand the architectural tradeoffs deeply
  • Experience building and operating CI/CD pipelines at massive scale — across thousands of daily builds, multiple programming languages, and complex pre-merge pipeline logic
  • Fluency in Go and/or Python; broad familiarity with TypeScript, Swift, or Android development environments is a strong signal
  • Strong background with distributed systems, Kubernetes, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred) — you understand the full stack of developer tooling from IDE to deployment
  • Experience with test infrastructure, integration test environments, or developer environment platforms — you understand what a great test experience looks like at scale
  • Genuine interest in or hands-on experience with agentic AI systems, automated code review, or AI-driven developer velocity programs — you have a clear point of view on how AI will reshape the software development lifecycle and want to be the one building it
  • Exceptional technical leadership, communication, and influence skills — you've unified cross-functional engineering teams around a shared vision and driven ambiguous, org-spanning initiatives to completion
  • Track record of mentoring senior engineers and elevating the technical bar across large, diverse engineering organizations

What we offer

  • Challenging, high-impact work to grow your career
  • Performance driven compensation with multipliers for outsized impact, bonus programs, and equity ownership
  • Top tier benefits to fuel your work, including supplemental health insurance, ancillary insurance, and mental health support programs
  • Access to the best AI tools on the market and continuous AI skill-building for every employee, technical or not 
  • Lifestyle wallet - a highly flexible employer-paid benefits spending account expenses beyond traditional benefits such as wellness, childcare, learning, and more.
  • Time off to recharge including company holidays, paid time off, sick time, paid volunteer time off, parental leave, and more!
  • Exceptional office experience with catered meals, events, and comfortable workspaces. 
  • Monthly commuter stipend to help offset in-office commuting costs

descriptions.job-0jm31wf:
会社紹介

ビットバンクはSBIグループの一員として新たな成長を目指す、暗号資産専業のスタートアップ企業です。
「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」をミッションに暗号資産技術の応用によって、人々の生活にビットコインが浸透し普及することを目指しています。
180名を超える社員のうち、20代〜30代のメンバーが約70％と若手中心ですが、40代以上の経験豊富なベテランも多数在籍しています。
同じビジョンを共有するメンバーが、それぞれの専門性を活かしながら、日々挑戦と成長を重ねています。私たちは当社が掲げるVision、Missionに共感し、そして3つのValuesを大切にしています。

■主なサービス
【bitbank. cc】
ビットコインをはじめ幅広く取り揃えた豊富な銘柄を取り扱っており、シンプルで軽量なデザインに加え、高い機能性を備えたスマートな取引所です。
また、金融庁の認可を受けた暗号資産交換業者として、安全性と信頼性の高い取引環境を実現しています

■子会社情報
【JADAT（日本デジタルアセットトラスト設立準備株式会社）】
日本デジタルアセットトラスト設立準備株式会社（JADAT）は、ビットバンク株式会社が有する最先端かつ国内最高セキュリティレベルの暗号資産管理に係るノウハウと、専業信託銀行グループである三井住友トラスト・グループが有する信託業務に係るノウハウを融合させたデジタルアセットの資産管理サービスを行う信託会社の設立準備会社です。

【Bitbank Ventures合同会社（Bitbank Ventures）】
Bitbank Ventures株式会社は、ビットバンク株式会社の100%出資により設立された投資子会社です。
暗号資産やブロックチェーンによるインターネット上の新たな価値移転の可能性に加え、AI技術の進化により注目される「AI × クリプト」領域など、将来を見据えた先端技術の動向を的確に捉えながら、未来の社会を支える革新的な取り組みを支援することを目的としています。

Vision

オープンでフェアな社会を実現する

Mission

ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる

Values

【 Integrity 】
何事にも真摯に取り組み、関わるすべての人を尊重する。
率直に意見し、言行に責任をもち、誠実であることを誇る。

【 Challenge 】
あらゆるチャンスを素早く捉え、失敗を恐れず、自らチャレンジし続ける。

【 One team 】
仲間を信じ、仲間と取り組み、仲間と共に成長する。

主なトピック

  • 2021年、ミクシィとセレスより75億円の資金調達を発表しました。
  • 子育てに合わせた多様な働き方を可能にする労働条件の整備や取り組みが評価され、「子育てサポート企業」として「くるみん認定」を取得しました。
  • 3年連続で「健康経営優良法人2025」に認定されました。
  • 2026年1月、本社オフィスを「東京ミッドタウン八重洲」へ移転。

募集ポジション

プラットフォームエンジニア（Platform Engineer）

募集背景

ビットバンクは「ビットコインの技術で、世界中にあらゆる価値を流通させる」というミッションのもと、国内トップクラスの規模を持つ暗号資産取引所として成長を続けています。

暗号資産取引所は24時間365日の高い稼働率が求められ、Webサービスとしての開発スピードと金融機関としてのセキュリティ・ガバナンスの両立が不可欠です。当社では各開発チームが自らインフラを構築する体制をとっており、インフラチームは全社で利用する共通基盤の整備を通じて、開発チームの生産性と安全性を支える Platform Engineering を推進しています。
しかし、開発チームの自律性と開発速度をさらに高めるためには、基盤の標準化やセルフサービス化を一層進めていく必要があります。

今後は開発環境のセルフサービス化やオブザーバビリティの推進、GitHub 運用の標準化に加え、金融機関として求められるセキュリティ水準の継続的な強化など、開発チーム全体の生産性とセキュリティ水準をさらに引き上げてまいります。

これらの取り組みを加速させるため、AWS を中心としたクラウド基盤の設計・構築に強みを持ち、開発者体験の向上を自ら推進できる Platform Engineer を募集します。

仕事内容

（雇入直後）

  • 開発者体験の標準化
    • GitHub Actions の共通テンプレート整備とリポジトリ初期構成の標準化
    • Amazon EKS 上のセルフホストランナーを活用した CI/CD 基盤の運用・改善
    • 社内向けインフラ設計標準ガイドラインの策定・運用
    • 開発チームと連携し、インフラ領域の課題解決と推進改善
  • 開発環境のセルフサービス化
    • オンデマンドな開発環境構築基盤の設計・実装
    • 複数 AWS アカウント・リポジトリにまたがる依存関係の整理と自動化パイプラインの構築
    • CloudFormation / CDK を用いた IaC 化によるポータビリティと再現性の向上
  • AI エージェントによるインフラ業務の効率化
    • 開発者自身が AI エージェントを活用しインフラのトラブルシューティングを効率的に行える仕組みづくり
    • AI エージェント が参照するコンテキスト（Rules, ドキュメント）の整備
  • AWS インフラのセキュリティ強化
    • 開発チームが安全にデリバリーできるセキュリティガードレールの設計・運用
    • AWS WAF をはじめとするアプリケーション防御策の設計・運用
    • AWS Organization を含めたインフラストラクチャ全般のセキュリティ運用・コンプライアンス対応
    • JIT（Just-In-Time）権限管理による最小権限アクセスの実現
    • セキュリティ関連サービスの検出結果をもとにしたリスク対応
    • 金融業界特有の規制要件に基づく継続的な改善
  • FinOps を通じたクラウドコストの最適化
    • RI / Savings Plans の継続的な購入・見直しによるコスト削減
    • Looker によるコスト可視化の高度化および定期レポートの設計・配信

（変更の範囲）

  • 同上

開発環境

  • インフラ
    • コンピューティング
      • Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service
      • AWS Fargate
      • AWS Lambda
      • Amazon EC2
    • OS

    • セキュリティ

    • プログラミング言語

    • コラボレーション

    • AI ツール

    • BIツール

必須要件

  • 当社のVision/Mission/Valuesに共感できる方
  • AWS を中心としたクラウドインフラの設計・構築・運用経験
  • CloudFormation / CDK / Terraform 等を用いた Infrastructure as Code の実務経験
  • 開発チーム向けの共通基盤・テンプレート・CI/CD パイプライン等の整備・提供経験
  • Datadog 等のオブザーバビリティツールの導入・運用経験
  • ステークホルダーと連携しながら業務を推進できるコミュニケーション能力
  • TypeScript または Python での開発経験
  • AI ツールを活用した開発・運用の効率化経験

歓迎要件

  • 複雑な依存関係を持つ開発環境のセルフサービス化経験
  • Kubernetes 上で動作する GitHub Actions において、リポジトリ単位で必要最小限の AWS権限を柔軟に付与する仕組みを設計・構築した経験

  • 金融システムなど、高いセキュリティ・コンプライアンス要件が求められる業界での実務経験

求める人物像

  • 開発者体験の向上を自分ごととして捉え、共通基盤の整備を主体的に推進できる方
  • 高いセキュリティレベルやガバナンスを意識しながら自動化や仕組み化によって開発チーム全体の生産性向上を追求できる方
  • 新しい技術やツールを主体的にキャッチアップし、チームへの提案・普及まで行える方
  • 金融機関として求められるセキュリティ・ガバナンスを理解し、責任ある行動ができる方
  • 他者と自分の違いを理解し相互理解をしながら開発を進め、会社や所属チームを良くしようと前向きに協力できる方
  • ロジカルな議論を通じて建設的なコミュニケーションができる方

本ポジションの魅力

  • 開発環境のセルフサービス化やガイドライン整備など、開発組織全体の生産性に直接影響を与える Platform Engineering が実践できる
  • 複数 AWS アカウントにまたがる大規模インフラの設計・運用を経験できる

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies - from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups - use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Build, improve, diagnose, fix, and measure things. Have outsized impact in your role supporting a rapidly scaling sales organization! The GTM sales team at Stripe works with new and existing businesses of all shapes and sizes. As a member of the Central Sales Strategy and Operations team, you’ll be responsible for overall productivity and effectiveness of the sales organization, partnering closely with senior sales leadership and the broader sales team to provide insights and analysis on core business performance metrics and drive key strategic sales initiatives.

What you’ll do

Partnering closely with the GTM leadership team, regional sales leaders to support sales teams, owning the in-depth monitoring and tracking of the business metrics, creation of key intelligence and insights to accelerate growth. 

Partner with key cross-functional stakeholders, including but not limited to Marketing, Finance & Strategy, Data Science, Seller Systems, and Strategic Operations to streamline and optimize our internal processes and run-the-business and planning deliverables (Stripe Rhythm of Business: Weekly Business Reviews, Monthly Business Reviews, Quarterly Business Reviews). Shape the processes and go-to-market support model for a rapidly growing company, and make a tangible impact on sales and operations.

Responsibilities

  • Support the GTM leadership with intelligence and insight to accelerate growth
  • Support Sales Strategy and Operations colleagues by standardizing global and regional common process that is currently decentralized
  • Deep dive into key performance metrics and drive deep understanding of business performance
  • Problem solve and structure analysis outcomes for complex sales operations challenges through data, analytics and insight
  • Identify new opportunities and areas of productivity efficiency gains for Regional sales leadership
  • Participate in projects defining go-to-market approaches, as well as in regular business and resource planning
  • Run analysis on key performance metrics, providing relevant insights for managing the business
  • Oversee implementation of enabling systems and tools, working closely with internal systems teams
  • Prepare weekly senior leader forecast materials and provide ongoing updates on key business growth/metrics to leadership teams
  • Manage bespoke projects and effectively manage stakeholders

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Has 7+ years of sales, strategy and operations experience in a high-tech growth environment, or operational experience in investment banking or management consulting or private equity or venture capital, or business insights / analytics roles
  • Advanced proficiency in SQL and other advanced analytics tools
  • Proficiency in BI visualization tools
  • Experience leveraging AI to analyze data / derive insights, automate processes, or create reports / dashboards
  • Has strong analytical skills and a structured approach to solving unique business problems. Has experience working with data and large data sets to identify trends and create insights to make recommendations to senior leaders
  • Has an enthusiastic “roll up your sleeves” mentality
  • Works well with a high degree of adaptability and flexibility in a fast paced, often ambiguous, and rapidly changing environment

Preferred qualifications

  • Prior experience at a growth stage Internet/software company
  • Prior experience in the payments industry

descriptions.job-0pyk0yn:
About us

Ether.fi is one of the largest crypto companies in the world, with over $10B in assets under management and a team of ~50, almost entirely technical staff. We've been profitable since day one and are focused on building real consumer financial applications.

We believe the future of finance is true on-chain banking. Our products — Stake, Liquid, and Cash — let users earn yield through DeFi strategies and spend their assets globally through our credit card program. You can view our growth publicly on Dune (https://dune.com/ether_fi/etherfi-cash)

Position overview

We're looking for a strong engineer to join credit card transaction team in ether.fi and contribute to the success of credit card program and the risk systems that sit on top of it.

The first pillar is the transaction stack: card authorization and every decline that shouldn't have happened. You will look into what's causing the user frictions based on the declines transactions and come up with pro-active solutions to prevent them.

The second pillar is fraud and risk. Today our defense is largely reactive; you will make it proactive on both sides of the line. Build the rules, monitoring, and internal tooling, and also use them: pull the data yourself, investigate the cases, work out what the attacker actually did, and turn that into the rule that catches it next time.

You'll work closely with Product, CX, and Compliance, and directly with our card program and fraud vendors.

What you'll do

  • Improve the card transaction experience: hunt down and eliminate the causes of declines, failed authorizations, stuck holds, and the frictions users actually hit when they spend

  • Make the card program better as a product; find where it breaks for real users, propose the fix, ship it

  • Hunt fraud and abuse patterns: card testing, cashback farming, merchant abuse, friendly fraud, trial and force-post abuse, multi-account rings

  • Own our fraud stack: rules, queues, and scoring logic in Sardine, plus real-time monitoring, alerting, and automated mitigation

  • Investigate live cases hands-on; query the transaction data, root-cause the pattern, and propose the rule or control that stops it recurring

  • Build internal tools, dashboards, and scripts that make our risk and CX teams dramatically more effective

What we are looking for

  • Strong fundamentals in software engineering and problem solving

  • 4+ years of professional coding experience, shipping products

  • Product sense; you care about the person on the other side of a declined transaction, and you'd rather fix the cause than close the ticket

  • Comfortable in the data, not just the codebase; strong instinct to dig into the data by querying it rather than asking someone else to

  • Genuine interest in adversarial problems; you find it satisfying to stare at noisy transaction data and spot the pattern that shouldn't be there, then explain why it's there

Plus if you have

  • Worked at a fintech, neobank, card issuer, or issuer processor

  • Experience on the card issuing side, or with a card transaction processor

  • Knowledge of card and payment fraud mechanics: card testing, BIN attacks, friendly fraud, merchant collusion, cashback farming

  • Built on a fraud decisioning or transaction monitoring platform, and sat on the operational side of one

  • Run fraud investigations or disputes yourself, not only supported the people who do

Perks and benefits

  • Competitive salary, performance-based incentives, and token allocation grant

  • Opportunity to work on multi-billion dollar products as part of a small team

  • Health, dental, and vision insurance plans

  • Global team with opportunity for travel and working out of our 3 offices around the world

  • 4 weeks work from anywhere

  • Exciting company events and team-building off-sites

descriptions.job-0fal4pr:
The CoinDCX Journey: Building the Future of Finance:

At CoinDCX, our mission is clear - to make crypto and blockchain accessible to every Indian and enable them to participate in the future of finance.

As India's first crypto unicorn valued at $2.45B, we are reshaping the financial ecosystem by building safe, transparent, and scalable products that power adoption at scale.

We believe that change starts together. It begins with bold ideas, relentless execution and people who want to build what's next.

If you're driven by purpose and thrive in environments where your work defines the next chapter of an industry, you'll feel right at home here.

About the Role

This isn't a typical Market Risk role.

This role is suited for a hands-on risk professional who can independently execute BAU monitoring, build practical dashboards and controls, analyse market events, and escalate issues with clarity across spot, derivatives, and custody-linked exposures. You will work closely with the Manager and cross-functional teams to strengthen risk measurement, liquidation and margin monitoring, liquidity and slippage views, governance processes, and day-to-day risk actions.

What You'll Do:

1) Risk Measurement & Monitoring (BAU)

Build, maintain, and run core risk views such as VaR (1-day/10-day), stress tests, scenario loss, and drawdown / regime indicators for key exposures including spot, perps / futures, and funding or basis-linked positions.

Monitor volatility, correlations, concentration, and tail-risk indicators on a daily basis; identify changes in risk posture and escalate material observations in a timely manner.

Prepare daily and periodic risk summaries with clear commentary, exceptions, and recommended follow-ups.

2) Limits, Appetite & Governance Support

Support the implementation and ongoing monitoring of risk limits across notional, leverage, concentration, liquidity / slippage, and basis or funding exposures.

Track breaches, exceptions, and threshold movements; maintain escalation logs, decision records, and supporting governance documentation.

Assist in drafting and maintaining runbooks, SOPs, and risk dashboards so that BAU processes remain consistent, auditable, and scalable.

3) Derivatives & Liquidation Risk Controls

Monitor margin and liquidation risk across derivatives books, including mark vs LTP behaviour, index / mark quality, liquidation outcomes, and tail-day stress performance.

Build and track metrics such as distance-to-liquidation (DTL), effective leverage, margin utilisation, and early-warning indicators at user, token, or portfolio level where relevant.

Partner with Product, Operations, and Engineering teams to improve practical guardrails such as risk checks, throttles, alerting logic, and reduce-only or similar protective actions.

4) Liquidity & Slippage Risk

Build and maintain liquidity risk views covering order book depth, spreads, market impact, slippage, and exit capacity under normal and stressed conditions.

Support stress liquidation cost analysis and time-to-exit estimation across key tokens, books, and liquidity regimes.

Highlight thin-liquidity, concentration, and execution-risk hotspots that may require tighter controls or closer monitoring.

5) Risk Support & Cross-Functional Analysis

Support analysis of venue constraints, hedgeability, pricing frictions, and operational limitations that can affect market risk outcomes.

Contribute to exposure monitoring across related areas such as stablecoin /
INR conversion impacts, treasury-linked positions, or exchange-specific market structure issues where relevant.

descriptions.job-02w4kgv:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

Stripe Terminal helps businesses extend their online presence into the physical world. Our mission is to make it as easy for businesses to accept in-person payments as the Stripe API has made it for online payments. With Terminal, businesses can create flagship retail experiences, extend their websites to pop-up stores, or enable mobile point-of-sale payments at their next event. All of this is built on the Stripe Payments Platform, so businesses can maintain a single view of customers and sales across online and offline channels.

Our hardware engineering team in Taiwan designs and builds the physical payment devices at the heart of that experience, including products such as the Stripe Reader S700 and Stripe Reader M2. We are expanding the team and seeking an experienced Senior Mechanical and Industrial Design Engineer who can own both the structural engineering and aesthetic form language of our next generation of payment terminals. This is a blended role. You will be equally comfortable driving design for manufacturability (DFM) for a plastic enclosure and sketching form concepts that express Stripe's design identity in hardware.

What you'll do

You will lead the industrial and mechanical design of next-generation Stripe Terminal payment devices, shaping their form, feel, usability, and structural performance from early concepts through mass production. You will partner with cross-functional teams and suppliers to deliver manufacturable, high-quality hardware, including enclosure design, color, material, and finish specifications, packaging, validation, and production readiness.

Responsibilities

Industrial design

  • Lead ideation and concept development through rapid hand sketching, digital sketching, and physical foam or 3D-printed models to explore form factors early in the product lifecycle.
  • Define the visual and tactile design language of Terminal hardware, including proportion, form, surface transitions, button feel, and overall product character.
  • Produce photorealistic product renders using KeyShot or similar tools to communicate design intent to cross-functional teams and executive stakeholders.
  • Define and manage color, material, and finish (CMF) specifications. Work directly with suppliers to qualify target surfaces, textures, and coatings.
  • Manage packaging design, working directly with suppliers to qualify final deliverables and the unboxing experience.
  • Apply ergonomics and human factors principles to ensure products are intuitive and comfortable for a diverse range of users and environments.
  • Maintain visual consistency and brand coherence across the Terminal hardware product family, in alignment with Stripe's design identity.

Mechanical engineering

  • Design mechanical components and assemblies using SolidWorks or Creo, following professional engineering standards.
  • Hands on experience in mechanical designs and drawings, assess manufacturability, and resolve technical problems.
  • Lead and plan problem-solving activities using scientific approaches, such as tolerance analysis, computer-aided engineering (CAE) and finite element method (FEM) simulations, design of experiments (DOE), and physical prototyping.
  • Independently analyze and verify mechanical designs, identify risks, and propose mitigations.
  • Manage bill of materials (BOM) cost and design schedules from a mechanical engineering perspective.
  • Prepare mechanical engineering deliverables, including BOMs, component specifications, and support for failure mode and effects analysis (FMEA) activities.
  • Review Design fixtures and calibration processes for high-precision mechanical assemblies.
  • Verify and qualify components in first-article builds from suppliers, and participate in pilot production.
  • Produce and maintain engineering documents, including specifications, design-for-excellence (DFx) guidelines, technical reports, and gate-review packages.
  • Partner with Quality and Reliability teams to support successful validation outcomes and improve hardware durability standards.
  • Support product compliance and certification activities, including Payment Card Industry (PCI) and regulatory certifications.

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements listed below. If you meet these requirements, we strongly encourage you to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

  • Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Industrial Design, or a closely related field.
  • 8+ years of hands-on product design experience spanning mechanical engineering and industrial design, with a portfolio of consumer or commercial hardware products. This includes experience designing consumer-grade plastic enclosures for handheld products, such as smartphones, tablets, or payment terminals, from concept through mass production.
  • Ability to communicate design concepts through hand or digital sketching at the pace of a design conversation, and experience defining CMF specifications with suppliers.
  • Solid understanding of manufacturing and mechanical production processes, with direct experience taking industrial design concepts through DFM, tooling, and production.
  • Proficiency in mechanical CAD software. Creo is required, and SolidWorks is a plus. Expertise in creating detailed 2D drawings and performing geometric dimensioning and tolerancing (GD&T) and tolerance analysis.
  • Familiarity with mold design, first-article inspection (FAI) processes, and process capability (Cpk) analysis, along with experience managing supplier and factory relationships.
  • Strong written and spoken English and Mandarin communication skills to collaborate directly with suppliers in Taiwan, Hong Kong, and mainland China throughout product development and production. Willingness to travel internationally, including to Hong Kong and mainland China, as needed.

Preferred qualifications

  • Proficiency in rendering software, with KeyShot strongly preferred. VRED or Blender experience is also valued.
  • Experience maintaining a coherent design language across a multi-SKU hardware product family or accessory ecosystem.
  • Familiarity with ergonomics methodologies, including grip studies, anthropometric data, and usability evaluations, applied to handheld device design.
  • Experience with point-of-sale hardware, payment terminals, or consumer electronics peripherals.
  • Knowledge of PCI hardware requirements, material properties, and associated manufacturing processes.
  • Proficiency in thermal calculations and an understanding of plastic material properties.
  • Experience with mechanical simulation tools and metal-part design.
  • Ability to create compelling design presentations for cross-functional and executive audiences, clearly articulating the rationale behind design decisions.

About the Role:

We're looking for a Security Engineer who is equally at home hardening a CI/CD pipeline, reviewing a change to the authentication system on the backend, and triaging a bug bounty submission before lunch.This is a hands-on, builder-first role - not a governance checkbox. You'll own security operations end-to-end, embedded directly into the engineering team and working closely with infrastructure, protocol and platform.

If you treat threat modeling as a design conversation and not a compliance exercise, you're our kind of person. You should only apply for this role if you are ready to come into the office every day and work in person with our team!

What You'll Do

Security Operations

  • Own day-to-day security operations: monitoring, alerting, triage, and response

  • Manage and monitor endpoint security via an EDR system - tune detections, investigate alerts, and drive incidents to resolution

  • Lead identity lifecycle management, including employee onboarding and off boarding (access provisioning, key rotation, deprovisioning)

Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management

  • Be the primary owner of our ImmuneFi program - triaging, reproducing, and responding to incoming submissions daily

  • Prioritize and track vulnerabilities through to remediation in close collaboration with protocol and engineering teams

  • Develop internal tooling and processes to make the bounty workflow faster and more consistent

DevSecOps & Pipeline Hardening

  • Audit and harden CI/CD pipelines - secrets management, supply chain integrity, SAST/DAST integration, build provenance

  • Own dependency security: identify and remediate vulnerable packages across repositories (yes, including the npm dependency hell)

  • Establish and enforce security standards across the SDLC

Infrastructure Security

  • Partner with the infrastructure team to review and harden cloud environments (access controls, network segmentation, least privilege, logging)

  • Contribute to threat modeling for new systems and architectural changes

  • Drive implementation of security tooling across the stack

Vendor & External Partner Management

  • Own relationships with external security vendors and service providers — holding them accountable toSLAs, managing scope, and ensuring findings are actioned

  • Evaluate and onboard new security tooling as the team and threat landscape evolve

What We're Looking For:

  • 5+ years of experience in software and security engineering, with meaningful time in a DevSecOps or security operations context

  • Strong software engineering fundamentals - you're a builder who writes code, not just policy

  • Hands-on experience hardening CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions, CircleCI, or similar) and cloud infrastructure (AWS, GCP, or equivalent)

  • Proficiency with endpoint security tooling (CrowdStrike or equivalent EDR)

  • Comfort owning identity and access management processes, including onboarding/offboarding workflows

Nice to Have:

  • CTF/security competition background

  • Contributions to open-source security tooling

What Success Looks Like:

In your first 90 days, you've mapped our attack surface, established a daily rhythm on ImmuneFi, and shipped at least a few meaningful PRs across the full stack. Within six months, you've built enough trust in the team that engineers come to you before shipping sensitive PRs, not after.

Since we opened our doors in 2009, the world of commerce has evolved immensely, and so has Square. After enabling anyone to take payments and never miss a sale, we saw sellers stymied by disparate, outmoded products and tools that wouldn’t work together.

So we expanded into software and started building integrated, omnichannel solutions – to help sellers sell online, manage inventory, offer buy now, pay later functionality, book appointments, engage loyal buyers, and hire and pay staff. Across it all, we’ve embedded financial services tools at the point of sale, so merchants can access a business loan and manage their cash flow in one place. Afterpay furthers our goal to provide omnichannel tools that unlock meaningful value and growth, enabling sellers to capture the next generation shopper, increase order sizes, and compete at a larger scale.

Today, we are a partner to sellers of all sizes – large, enterprise-scale businesses with complex operations, sellers just starting, as well as merchants who began selling with Square and have grown larger over time. As our sellers grow, so do our solutions. There is a massive opportunity in front of us. We’re building a significant, meaningful, and lasting business, and we are helping sellers worldwide do the same.

The Role

Square is building a best-in-class, high-impact field sales organization, and we are looking for an exceptional Territory Account Executive — someone who consistently exceeds expectations, takes full ownership of their territory, and brings Square’s mission of economic empowerment directly to the businesses that need it most.

This is a field-driven, execution-focused role designed for individuals who thrive in dynamic, demanding environments. You will spend most of your week out in the market — meeting businesses, conducting live demos, and closing deals with confidence. The pace is fast, the expectations are high, and your ability to operate strategically and decisively will determine your success.

You will serve as Square’s presence and competitive advantage in one of our highest-opportunity markets — responsible for building pipeline from the ground up, elevating Square’s visibility in your community, establishing high-value partnerships, and helping local businesses grow through our ecosystem of industry-leading software and hardware.

If you are motivated by impactful work, driven to outperform, and eager to join a high-performance team with high standards, this role is built for you.

You will:

Lead your market with disciplined, in-person execution

  • Spend ~80% of your week in the field — walking your territory, engaging local businesses, and driving 50–60 targeted business visits each week.
  • Run a full-cycle, self-sourced sales motion: generate leads, identify needs, deliver compelling demos, and close deals across Square’s full product suite.

Establish yourself as the go-to Square expert in your city

  • Build strong, trust-based relationships with local sellers by being present, reliable, and value-driven.
  • Partner cross-functionally to ensure a seamless onboarding experience and fast time-to-value for new sellers.
  • Implement a disciplined referral strategy to turn every new customer into future opportunities.

Build a high-velocity pipeline from the ground up

  • Develop a repeatable top-of-funnel engine through door-to-door outreach, community engagement, events, networking, and targeted partnerships.
  • Work with channel partners to generate a consistent, high-quality referral stream that grows over time.

Master your verticals and sell with precision

  • Build deep expertise in key verticals — including restaurants, retail, and services — to diagnose challenges and position the right Square solutions.
  • Sell consultatively and competitively, staying proactive and strategic throughout the sales cycle.

descriptions.job-08r0ycf:
About Bullish

Bullish is an institutionally focused global digital asset platform that provides market infrastructure and information services. These include: Bullish Exchange – a regulated and institutionally focused digital assets spot and derivatives exchange, integrating a high-performance central limit order book matching engine with automated market making to provide deep and predictable liquidity. Bullish Exchange is regulated in Germany, Hong Kong, and Gibraltar. CoinDesk Indices – a collection of tradable proprietary and single-asset benchmarks and indices that track the performance of digital assets for global institutions in the digital assets and traditional finance industries. CoinDesk Data - a broad suite of digital assets market data and analytics, providing real-time insights into prices, trends, and market dynamics. CoinDesk Insights – a digital asset media and events provider and operator of Coindesk.com, a digital media platform that covers news and insights about digital assets, the underlying markets, policy, and blockchain technology.

Reports to:

Director, Engineering

Engineering Organization & Culture

At Bullish, we are engineering the institutional standard for the digital asset industry. Our mission is to build a platform where security and compliance are the foundational core, requiring a commitment to technical excellence that goes beyond simply delivering code. We operate as a global engineering organization, setting a high bar in a demanding environment for those driven to do the best work of their careers alongside world-class peers.

We value engineers who treat development as a craft and own the outcome from concept to deployment. You will be expected to navigate the unknown, bring structure to ambiguity, and help shape the frameworks and processes that drive our global teams forward. We refuse to compromise on quality and seek problem solvers who thrive on high-impact technical challenges.

The Team: Trading Platform Engineering

The Trading Platform Engineering team is responsible for designing and optimizing the high-performance, mission-critical foundation that powers our trading activities. Operating at the intersection of software and hardware, the team builds low-latency systems that demand expert-level proficiency in Linux kernel internals, networking pipelines, and distributed systems architecture. The team focuses on architectural excellence, reliability, determinism, and the relentless elimination of tail latency.

What You’ll Do

  • High-Performance Service Development: Design, build, and optimize high-performance systems using C and Java.

  • Kernel & User Space Engineering: Engineer performance-critical components across user space and kernel interfaces, focusing on memory, scheduling, I/O, and networking paths.

  • Advanced Networking: Develop and tune networking pipelines (multicast/unicast UDP and TCP) and implement kernel-bypass or fast-path networking (e.g., DPDK, XDP).

  • Kernel Optimization: Interact with and optimize Linux kernel subsystems, including memory management, schedulers, device drivers, and filesystems (VFS).

  • Latency & Determinism: Optimize systems for deterministic latency through CPU isolation, thread pinning, NUMA locality, cache awareness, and lock contention reduction.

  • Distributed Systems: Apply distributed systems patterns, such as sequencer (virtual synchrony), for total ordering and consistency.

  • Profiling & Debugging: Use tools like perf, strace, eBPF, and flame graphs to identify and eliminate system bottlenecks.

  • Operational Excellence: Collaborate cross-functionally to deliver robust production systems with clear SLOs, reproducible performance tests, and actionable runbooks.

What You’ll Bring

  • Language Mastery: Expert-level proficiency in Java

  • Linux Internals: Deep understanding of Linux kernel internals, including memory management, driver models, and scheduler tuning.

  • Low-Latency Expertise: Practical experience in end-to-end latency optimization, jitter reduction, and techniques like lock-free or wait-free programming.

  • Networking Depth: Experience with socket options, buffer sizing, epoll, io_uring, RSS, and NIC queue configuration.

  • Distributed Systems Knowledge: Understanding of sequencer-based total order broadcast, partial order broadcast and the tradeoffs between latency, throughput, and availability.

  • Concurrency & Systems: Solid understanding of concurrency, synchronization primitives, and memory models.

  • Analytical Mindset: A focus on measurement over assumption, using benchmarks and profiles to drive decisions and communicate complex tradeoffs.

  • Collaborative Craftsmanship: Commitment to high code quality through rigorous reviews, mentoring, and clear documentation.

Nice To Haves

  • Trading Infrastructure: Experience in financial markets (e.g., market data, order routing, or FIX/exchange-native protocols).

  • Time Synchronization: Familiarity with PTP or other high-precision time synchronization for low-latency environments.

  • Observability: Experience using eBPF and tracing for observability in production.

  • Hardware Interfacing: Knowledge of RDMA, NIC offloads (TSO, LRO), or experience maintaining kernel modules and device drivers.

  • JVM Tuning: Experience with low-latency JVM practices and deterministic GC tuning for Java-based systems.

  • Advanced Benchmarking: Deep knowledge of benchmarking methodology, including workload design and variance analysis.

Bullish is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are fast evolving and striving towards being a globally-diverse community. With integrity at our core, our success is driven by a talented team of individuals and the different perspectives they are encouraged to bring to work every day.

Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you have an opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

The Performance and Talent Planning team is part of Stripe’s broader Talent and Development organization. We shape how Stripes grow their careers and do their best work.

We build the programs, systems, and insights that help managers develop strong teams, help leaders plan for the future, and give Stripes clear opportunities to grow. Our work spans performance, talent planning, career development, succession, and organizational insights. Our goal is to make Stripe a place where talented people can build lasting careers and have an outsized impact.

What you’ll do

In this role, you will help translate Stripe’s performance and talent philosophy into scalable, global experiences. You will work across People Products, People Insights, Employee Relations, People Partners and other partner teams to design programs and systems that are clear for users, operationally durable, and aligned with Stripe’s future needs. You will bring a product mindset to all you do, starting with data driven problem statements, qualitative and quantitative signals, an understanding of the end-to-end user experience, an iterative design process, and an obsession with continuous improvement over time. You will be comfortable operating across time zones and navigating competing perspectives, incomplete information, and urgent priorities.

A Day in the Life

You start your day by reviewing your agenda in Slack or asking your AI agent to summarize ongoing work and priorities. Energized by a mix of workstream meetings across People Products, Manager Enablement, and M&A Transitions, you check overnight updates from teammates across time zones. Colleagues in Dublin have shared feedback that keeps the launch plan moving, while teammates in Melbourne have raised thoughtful questions about how a new performance process will integrate into the existing reporting capabilities they rely on for annual talent planning.

These questions are exactly the kind of challenge you value. They push you to build with a user-first mindset, anticipate downstream impacts, and mitigate risks before they emerge. You draw on expertise from across the organization while balancing the responsibility of integrating global perspectives, designing seamless end-to-end experiences, and coordinating work across interconnected teams. A new question sparks a new connection, and you quickly identify another stakeholder who should be brought into the next phase of the program.

As the day progresses, updates from cross-functional partners show steady progress across multiple fronts, but one critical area stalls. Rather than waiting for next week's meeting, you escalate immediately to keep momentum high and de-risk the program timeline. You end the day energized by the complexity of the work, the curiosity and collaboration of your colleagues, and the opportunity to continue to build, solve, and innovate every day.

Responsibilities

  • Drive and scale Stripe’s performance philosophy and practices. Design and improve performance experiences that help Stripes understand expectations, grow through feedback, and make meaningful contributions.
  • Evolve performance and talent tooling. Partner with People Products and cross-functional stakeholders to translate program needs into scalable systems, processes, and user journeys.
  • Strengthen career growth and talent investment. Help shape the programs, mechanisms, and insights that enable career development, talent planning, succession, and thoughtful investment in Stripe’s people as the company grows.
  • Lead complex, cross-functional workstreams. Build alignment among global stakeholders; surface risks and dependencies early; make progress in ambiguous environments; and unblock critical decisions quickly.
  • Use insights to improve outcomes. Define clear problem statements, gather qualitative and quantitative data, and use those insights to refine strategy, programs, and execution.

Who you are

You are a systems thinker who can connect the details of a program or product experience to the broader organizational context. You are energized by ambiguity and complexity, and thrive in bringing just enough structure, clarity, and strong momentum to the work. You build trusted relationships, communicate directly and thoughtfully, and create accountability across teams, with speed.

Minimum requirements

  • 10+ years of experience building and scaling global People or HR experiences, with experience across both process and product or systems design
  • Experience leading complex programs in fast-paced, ambiguous environments where high ownership and cross-functional problem solving are expected.
  • Strong systems thinking: the ability to understand how people, processes, tools, policies, and organizational decisions influence one another over time and how to augment workflows and processes using AI tools.
  • A demonstrated ability to build enduring, trusted stakeholder relationships; communicate effectively across levels and functions; and establish clear decision-making and accountability mechanisms.
  • A disciplined approach to problem solving. You begin with the “why,” define and refine problem statements steeped in both quantitative and qualitative data, and continuously ask “is this the right problem to solve, at the right time?”
  • High agency and sound judgment. You identify opportunities or risks, take action quickly, and escalate thoughtfully when progress is blocked.
  • Deep alignment with Stripe’s Operating Principle, Obsess over Talent. You believe that people are one of Stripe’s greatest unlocks: attracting exceptional talent, creating environments where they can thrive, building systems that support growth, and recognizing meaningful contributions.
  • Curiosity and humility. You are a continuous learner who seeks to understand before acting, welcomes ideas from many sources, and is willing to change course when new evidence suggests a better path.

Preferred qualifications

  • 10+ years of experience across a diverse portfolio of People programs: talent management, organizational development, leadership and/or executive development, program and talent operations, and compensation and benefits
  • People product design and management experience in high growth environments with fast iterative cycles, changing priorities, and a steady stream of feature requests and backlog
  • Experience and excellence leading executive level talent discussions that influence People strategy, with humility, curiosity, and a grounded presence
